findings.element: Wizard step 2 — clear-X inside every filter trigger (.custom-select-trigger), e.g. Kantone and TU's
findings.finding: Because the trigger lays out three children with justify-content:space-between, the clear-X sits at the horizontal centre of the control, so clicking the middle of a filter that already has a value silently wipes that value instead of reopening the panel.
findings.user_impact: The analyst loses filter selections they already made at the exact moment they try to review or extend them, with no notice, and can end up running an evaluation over a far broader scope than intended.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the clear-X to the far right edge of the trigger (before or after the caret) and shrink its hit area to its own glyph so the centre of the control always opens the panel.

evidence.action: Measured the trigger with elementFromPoint at its horizontal centre (trigger 542px wide, centre x=789, clear-X spans x=769–789), then clicked the centre of the Kantone trigger holding ['AG'] and of the TU's trigger holding ['BLS'].
evidence.observed: elementFromPoint(centre) returned 'canton-clear' / 'tu-clear'; the click reset Kantone state ['AG'] → [] with the label back to 'All cantons' and TU's ['BLS'] → [], the panel did not open, and nothing told the user the value had been destroyed.

findings.element: Scheduled reports → Edit action (wizard opened for 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich')
findings.finding: Edit opens the wizard titled with the schedule's name and a 'Scheduled' badge but loads none of the saved configuration, and hides the schedule section entirely.
findings.user_impact: The user believes they are adjusting an existing schedule while actually looking at a blank default, so they either give up or unknowingly replace a working schedule's period, TUs, cantons and lines with defaults — and cannot see or change its frequency at all.
findings.suggested_fix: Prefill the wizard from the stored schedule (period, days, all six filters) and keep the schedule section visible with its current frequency, or block Edit until prefill exists.

evidence.action: Clicked Edit on the scheduled report 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich' and inspected the wizard state.
evidence.observed: Title showed the schedule name with a 'Scheduled' badge, but state.selectedPeriod had reset to 'cur_month' and TU/cantons/lines were all empty; the schedule section was hidden so the frequency was neither visible nor editable.

findings.element: Evaluations list — row actions on 'Fertig' rows of type Rohdaten Export, Linienanalyse DPM and Datenqualitätsindex
findings.finding: Only 9 of 28 rows expose an 'Anzeigen' button and the row name is not clickable, so 10 finished evaluations offer no way to be opened.
findings.user_impact: An analyst who waited for an evaluation to finish reaches a dead end — the list says the work is done but there is no path to the result and no explanation of why this row differs from the ones that can be opened.
findings.suggested_fix: Give every row with status 'Fertig' an Anzeigen affordance (and make the row name clickable), or, where a type genuinely has no viewable output, replace the missing button with a labelled alternative such as 'Download' plus a reason.

evidence.action: Enumerated row actions across all 28 rows of the evaluations list and attempted to open finished rows by clicking the row name.
evidence.observed: 9 of 28 rows had an 'Anzeigen' button; 10 of the 19 'Fertig' rows (all Rohdaten Export, all Linienanalyse DPM, all Datenqualitätsindex) had none, and the row name had no onclick and cursor:auto so clicking it did nothing.

findings.element: Wizard step 3 — Run Now with the schedule box ticked, and the resulting toast
findings.finding: Running with a schedule configured confirms only the immediate run and the new schedule never appears in Geplante Berichte, so the scheduling half of the action is silently unconfirmed.
findings.user_impact: The user cannot tell whether the recurring schedule they just set up was saved, so they either assume a report will arrive weekly when it will not, or re-create the same schedule repeatedly.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the confirmation state the full outcome ('Evaluation started — and scheduled weekly, next run 03.09.2026') and add the schedule to the Geplante Berichte list immediately.

evidence.action: Ticked the schedule box, set a frequency, clicked Run Now, then opened Geplante Berichte.
evidence.observed: Toast read 'Evaluation started — running now' with no mention of the schedule, the app returned to the list, and the new schedule was not present in Geplante Berichte.

findings.element: Wizard step 2 — Kantone dropdown panel (vs. RPV, Verkehrsmittel, TU's, Linien, Haltestellen)
findings.finding: Kantone is the only one of six visually identical multi-select panels that closes after the first pick, so adding a second canton requires reopening it — which lands the user on the centre-mounted clear-X and wipes the first pick.
findings.user_impact: A user who has learned multi-select from the other five filters cannot select more than one canton by mouse, and each retry destroys the selection they already had, blocking a multi-canton evaluation.
findings.suggested_fix: Make Kantone behave like the other five panels — stay open after a pick and close only on outside click, Esc, or an explicit Done.

evidence.action: Picked one option in each of the six filter panels and then attempted a second pick without reopening; then attempted to add a second canton by mouse twice.
evidence.observed: RPV, Verkehrsmittel, TU's, Linien and Haltestellen all stayed open and accepted a second value (e.g. 'BLS' → 'BLS, CJ'); Kantone closed on the first pick, and a second canton could not be added by mouse in two attempts.

gaps: wizard step 3, notify-by-email toggle + email input: listed in not_exercised, so whether the address is validated or any confirmation is given is unknown
wizard step 3, Run Now: no loading/running state is recorded between the click and the toast, so whether the user gets progress feedback for a long evaluation is unknown

evaluations list: the map does not record whether the freshly run evaluation appears in the list (or with which status) after Run Now returns the user there, so the create-flow's closing feedback loop is unverified

wizard step 2, cascade between filters: the map records only that picking cantons/TUs 'did not visibly narrow' the Linien list — it does not state whether cascading is intended, so this is unresolved rather than a finding
wizard step 1, Next button: enablement was observed only for the reversed-range case; whether Next is blocked when no period or no filter is set was not exercised
saved evaluations: no rename/duplicate/re-run action was exercised on a completed evaluation, so managing an existing (non-scheduled) evaluation beyond delete is unrecorded
EN/DE switch: recon ran in both languages but the map records no per-control language behaviour, so mid-flow language switching (e.g. does an auto-generated evaluation name re-translate) is unknown

login: 'Passwort vergessen?' and the topbar nav (Startseite / Q.Reports / Fotoalbum / Q-Messungen) are onclick="return false" dead links — recorded as out of scope, so no dead-end judgement is made on them
